title: Gate-or
description: "Gate-or" is a gatekeeper with teeth. A giant alligator bursts through a crumbling brick wall, eye locked on you, grinning like it has been guarding this threshold forever. Every gate has a keeper, and you must confront this keeper to cross the threshold.
In daylight the gator is a deep jungle green against shards of silver and rainbow. Under blacklight the whole scene floods electric blue and the scales glow like they are charged.

title: Hanged Man
description: "Hanged Man" is built around the twelfth card of the tarot, the card of surrender and seeing the world from a new angle. Two hands reach up toward an all-seeing triangle while a skull below opens like a vessel, and the number 12 repeats across the canvas like a mantra.

In daylight it is a stark black-and-white study wrapped in streaks of color. Under blacklight the hands fade into deep blue and the triangle, symbols and numbers ignite. Let go, hang upside down, and see what you have been missing.

title: King of Swords
description: "King of Swords" is the ruler of the mind: clear thinking, hard truths and the courage to cut through illusion. A horned skull wears the crown here, pierced by a blade, while a cactus stands guard and a field of X's and O's plays out the game of decisions overhead.
Painted in fluorescent color, this piece comes alive under blacklight with hot pink, neon green and electric orange.

images.alt: King of Swords in a room (blacklight)
King of Swords framed on a wall (blacklight)
King of Swords print size comparison (blacklight)

title: Lotus Head
description: "Lotus Head" shows a skull crowned by a blooming lotus, the flower that rises clean out of the mud. It is a reminder that awakening grows out of the same ground as decay, and that something beautiful can open right out of the mind.
Under blacklight the petals blaze neon orange and green above a skull that melts into deep violet shadow.

images.alt: Lotus Head framed on a wall (blacklight)

title: Palm Shaman
description: "Palm Shaman" brings a skull-faced medicine keeper to life between four swaying palm trees. Crowned with a fiery headdress and wrapped in green spirals of energy, the shaman stands at the center of a tropical dream, a guide between this world and the next.
In daylight the piece is warm and sun-washed. Under blacklight it turns into a glowing night ceremony, with neon spirals, palms and feathers floating on electric blue.

title: Sacred Heart
description: "Sacred Heart" lifts the anatomical heart into something holy. Spread on flaming wings and marked with an open, all-seeing eye, the heart radiates beams of light out of a swirling vortex, as if it is the true center of perception.
In daylight the rays shimmer silver and holographic. Under blacklight the wings flare neon pink and orange, floating in deep blue.

title: The Horse and the Hermit
description: I painted The Horse and the Hermit live during the show and finished it that night. The hermit is the anglerfish skull. In the tarot, the Hermit chooses to leave society, not to shun it, but to better understand himself. He holds out his lantern to guide anyone willing to make the journey to the light, and all will be illuminated. The Hermit gives back the lessons he learned in isolation.

That story has a special meaning to me. I spent years traveling in my bus, camping in the middle of nowhere, painting and going deep within myself to understand who I am. That light is what I want to give to people.
The seahorse is the year of the horse, the fire horse: an active energy, an energy of doing. It's the energy I want to bring to sharing my light with people, and this show was an example of that.

images.alt: The Horse and the Hermit in a room (blacklight)
The Horse and the Hermit in a room (daylight)

title: Decay
description: Unveil the enchanting world of 'Decay,' where vibrant mushrooms emerge from a skull, illuminating your space with mysterious beauty.
Bring an evocative piece into your space that inspires curiosity and conversation. This artwork offers a striking focal point that transforms any room.

title: Trinity
description: Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant colors and mystical allure with the original art piece 'Trinity', featuring three glowing mushrooms that captivate the imagination.
Bring a sense of wonder and magic into your home with this captivating art piece. Let 'Trinity' transform your space into a conversation starter and an oasis of creativity.

title: Jar
description: Engage with nature’s beauty on a microscopic scale with this captivating 8x8 fine art print, featuring neon mushroom spores that pop with vibrant colors.
Illuminate your space with the charm and curiosity of the microscopic world, transforming any room into a conversation starter.

title: Vase
description: "Vase" turns the female body into a vessel. Her torso becomes the vase itself atop the threshold, with fiery blossoms growing out of the open top. It is a celebration of the body as a container for life, where creation is always quietly blooming.
In daylight she glows warm orange against a storm of electric blue and hot pink strokes. Under blacklight the background drops into deep blue and the flowers and outlines light up neon.

title: Threshold Guardian
description: "Threshold Guardian" stands at the doorway between the known and the unknown. In every hero's journey there is a guardian at the edge of the next world, and here she is: a bare-shouldered figure whose head dissolves into a blaze of red, yellow and blue, as if her mind has already crossed over.

Ancient symbols surround her, from pyramids and spirals to a rising serpent and birds in flight across the top. To pass her you have to let go of who you were. Painted in fluorescent color, this piece glows hot pink, neon green and red under blacklight.

title: Summers on Shavano
description: "Summers on Shavano" is a love letter to Colorado summers in the high country, when the wildflowers open and the hummingbirds come zipping through. A ruby-throated hummingbird hovers in front of a blazing flower, drinking in the sweetness of a season that never lasts long enough up on the mountain.
Rays of holographic light burst out behind the bird like the summer sun coming over the peak. Under blacklight the feathers turn electric green and the flower glows hot orange.

title: Heart
description: "Heart" honors the 24/7 work our heart does to keep us alive, recognizing the industrial organ's effort to pump our bodies full of the lifeblood of the universe.

pairMockup.alt: Heart Daylight and Blacklight prints framed side by side

title: Vision
description: "Vision" explores the power of perception, focusing on the light of the universe that animates the world around us.

pairMockup.alt: Vision Daylight and Blacklight prints framed side by side

title: Cosmic Child
description: "Cosmic Child" displays electric energy feeling alive and pulsating, giving the sense that the subject is connected to something much larger and timeless—a universe that hums beneath the surface of individuality.

images.alt: Cosmic Child framed on a wall (blacklight)
Cosmic Child framed on a wall (daylight)

pairMockup.alt: Cosmic Child Daylight and Blacklight prints framed side by side

title: Portal
description: "Portal" evokes a sense of transition or passage, as if the viewer is peering into a portal or a vortex leading somewhere unknown.

pairMockup.alt: Portal Daylight and Blacklight prints framed side by side

title: Duality
description: "Duality" captures the ever-present tension between life and death. That life and death are not merely opposites but layers of the same complex design.

pairMockup.alt: Duality Daylight and Blacklight prints framed side by side

title: Gamma Ray
description: "Gamma Ray" captures a burst of pure energy. A glowing form rises out of the center of the canvas, its mushroom-like crown blasting light outward, surrounded by the Roman numeral XVII, the number of the Star card, a symbol of hope and renewal.
In daylight it crackles with black, white and fiery orange. Under blacklight the beams turn neon teal and the whole piece radiates like it is giving off its own light. Original painting, 16" x 20".

images.alt: Gamma Ray framed on a wall (blacklight)
Gamma Ray framed on a wall (daylight)

title: Double Vision
description: "Double Vision" plays with the idea of seeing two worlds at once. A coiling serpent shaped like an S carries an open eye, while beams of neon light cut through the canvas like two realities overlapping.

In daylight it is a riot of rainbow geometry. Under blacklight the serpent turns deep indigo and the background lights up acid green, so you really do get two paintings in one. Original painting, 16" x 20".

images.alt: Double Vision framed on a wall (blacklight)
Double Vision framed on a wall (daylight)

title: Pregnant with Death
description: Emerging from this cosmic glow is the Mother Goddess—a transcendent being who represents the ultimate connection between creation and the divine. Her outstretched wings and radiant form embody the sacred link between the giver of life and the creator of all. The skull, carried within her like an unborn child, symbolizes the fundamental truth that to grant life is to also embrace death. In this mesmerizing portrayal, life and death coexist, reminding us that every act of creation inherently bears the promise of an ending.

title: Moon
description: "Moon" is a study in texture. A heavy, sculpted silver moon hangs in a sky of thick, swirling blue brushstrokes, the paint built up so the surface catches light like real lunar rock.
It is a quiet, meditative piece that brings the pull of the night sky into your space.

title: Birdhouse
description: "Birdhouse" is a layered, woven abstract. Strips of pattern and color are stacked like the slats of a nest, with frenzied strokes of paint building a home from scraps the way a bird would.
Under blacklight the layers separate into glowing threads of neon green, pink and orange, and the piece seems to vibrate on the wall.

title: Vulva
description: "Vulva" honors the source of all life, the gateway every one of us came through. Raw, layered strokes of color burst through a lattice of bold bars, a celebration of creation, birth and the sacred feminine.
Under blacklight the hidden layers glow hot pink, orange and neon blue.

title: Face
description: "Face" is a sculpted portrait made of flowing lines, with eyes, nose and lips carved out of thick paint and outlined in candy colors. Look at it long enough and the features shift and rearrange, the way a face changes depending on who is looking.
Under blacklight the outlines light up neon pink, blue and green and the face seems to float off the canvas.

title: Traffic
description: "Traffic" is a big neon X crossing a field of stacked bars, part stop sign, part crossroads. It captures the feeling of being stuck between lanes and the moment you finally choose your direction.
In daylight it reads black, white and silver. Under blacklight the X ignites in rainbow color over glowing blue.

title: Kafree
description: "Kafree" is a radiant mask of a skull crowned in green rays, with a strand of DNA running down its center like a spine of light. It speaks to what we inherit and what we choose to pass on, the code that connects ancestors to the living.
Under blacklight the mask glows a fiery orange inside a halo of neon green.

title: Transformation Crow
description: The crow is a symbol of transformation. This canvas has gone through its own transformation. This canvas started as a therapy piece at a time in my life when I was feeling overwhelmed with emotions that I didn’t understand. Painting helps me move through emotions and helps me to see things clearer. After some time I had moved through the emotions and didn’t fell the need to finish the piece in any capacity. So I spray painted over it first with black, It happened to be valentines day when I decided to studied roses for a tattoo I wanted to do on myself. by the end of the day I couldn’t stop seeing roses. So I spray painted a rose on the canvas. This happened the first week I got alone after being in a group for a few months. when at my campsite I started seeing crows. I didn’t realize they were crows, back home crows are way smaller but in the desert these birds looked like stealth bombers doing precise tactical maneuvers in the air. After leaving that spot in quartzite I rejoined some friends in Sedona. Once again I saw two crows gilding through the air. on 2/2/2022 I pulled 2 taro cards asking to make clear the dichotomy within myself. one of the cards happened to be the transformation card. I pulled a card from another deck and it had a black bird on it. It all just felt like coincidence until my friend left a bottle of wine in my bus, I was getting dressed the next morning when I noticed a crow with a crown on the label. Now it was in my house I couldn’t ignore it. I shared this with my friend and she shared with me some pages from an animal medicine book about the meaning of the crow. “The crow is the keeper of sacred law” “The crow sees simultaneously the three fates past present and future” “Crow is an omen of change” “Crow medicine signifies a firsthand knowledge of higher order of right and wrong than that indicated by laws created by human culture” I wanted to honor the message of the crow with this piece. The crows ability to hold balance of all realms.

title: Warrior Cactus
description: On the same trip that inspired the elder cactus, I looked up at another dyeing cactus and the way it was decaying reminded me of a spartan helmet. In this piece I wanted to depict the warrior side of death. The warrior caries out the will of the king. Death is an inevitable end to the realm and its the warriors job to surrender when the time comes. when we think of warriors we often think of the fight or forward momentum. But the warriors dichotomy is one of push and pull. A wise warrior knows when to retreat or surrender. Both fighting and surrender take strength.

title: Elder Cactus
description: I took a micro dose of mushrooms with a friend and we went for a walk in the desert. My intention for this trip was to connect with the part of me that is connected to the all that exists in the future. We came upon a dyeing cactus my friend points out how they become wood when they die. Patches of the green flesh fading in to wood. Death seemingly creeping up from the ground. the base rotting the life around the dying cactus seemingly pulled inward to support there elder. Watching this cactus die reminded me of watching my grandpa die. With the last signs of life leaving through the head surrounded and supported by the love of the people around them. I realize that the future is death. We spend a lot of time planning for the future thinking about where well be, who well be. If you spend to much time thinking about the future you don’t live in the present. Death is a uniting experience. It unites us with the all when we die and it unites the people around us when we die. Enjoy your life while you still have it.

images.alt: Elder Cactus framed on a wall (daylight)

title: Ouroboros
description: The Ouroboros came into my life during a transitional period. The Ouroboros is one of the oldest symbols that spans cultures. Depicting a serpent or dragon eating its self. Its symbolic for the infinite nature of existence, as well as the cycle of creation and destruction. The serpent consumes its self at the same rate in witch it produces its self. There is a point of unconsciousness in the whole thing where the serpent is unaware it is its self it is consuming. This is similar to the growth process we go through in life. We can only grow at the rate in witch we are able to change and produce new habits. We share a point of unconsciousness as well it doesn’t appear to us that much changes day to day but when you look back a month or a year you can see all the progress you have made. In order to become a new you the old you must die, much like consuming yourself this can be a painful process.

title: Fiery Water
description: A friend asked me my astrological sign. I told her I was a Scorpio, she said I was a fiery water sign. I didn’t understand what she meant by this analytically. But it made sense. shortly after this interaction I spent some time alone connecting to myself and painting. In this piece I tried to come to an understanding of what it meant to be a fiery water sign. This painting showed me how despite being opposite polarities fire and water can coexist together. I think what it means to be a fiery water sign is to hold the polarities of life in a balance being able to move between them effortlessly.

title: Covid-19 Self Portrait
description: I was working on a self portrait in September 2021 when I contracted Covid-19. Despite the lack of energy, I had a desire to feel normal and not waste my time off from work being sick. So I decided to work on my self portrait painting the way I felt and not the way I looked.

title: Rams Skull
description: “Rams skull” Came from the same time in my life as “Anxiety” and “Warrior Program”. Going through the final transition of working a 9-5 to living in a bus my mind was plagued with the demons of self doubt. Once again the horned figure representing the warrior archetype came to me in this form at this time in my life to represent the strength of being able to coexist with your demons. Still moving Forward in your pursuit despite self doubt knowing that you are doing the work you were meant to do.

title: Bird
description: In my personal mythology the bird represents the magician archetype.  The magician sees the unseen realms.  In this depiction of the bird it seemingly blends into the world around it with the use of the same textures.

title: Warrior Program
description: In my personal mythology horned creatures represents the warrior archetype. The grid background represents the digital space. the digital space being a space created purely from electronic signals similarly to the brain. In this piece the horned Figure appears to us as a skull with human lips. the Skull With human lips represents the transition from the physical realm to the spiritual realm. A real Consisting mainly of wave forms similarly to the digital realm being fed waves of alternating current. Hardware being a receiver for signals from satellites. The digital signals being received are symbolic of the spiritual messages from the soul that we receive. The warriors job is to carry out the will of the king the ruler of the real who is counseled by the magician who is connected to the realms beyond. The “Warrior Program” Acknowledges the Warriors connection to the realm beyond through doing work that serves the individuals purpose.

title: Anxiety
description: In September 2021 I was finishing up my bus build. One of the final things that had to be done is get the bus towed to have the Breaks fixed. This meant hooking up the past 2.5 years of my life not to mention my future to the back of a tow truck to drive an hour away. my future would literally out of my hands. While communicating with the garage I got Covid-19, witch meant I had to use all of my PTO to quarantine so i had to get the bus towed before I had to go back to work. once the bus left the driveway it was time to clean, as well as pack things up to move into the bus. This piece was me processing my anxiety at the time.
